parsed.evidence: The white support panel in both the close and wide views isolates a small, rectangular structure located at the bottom center. In the wide RGB view, this object appears as a small, light-colored (beige/grey) rectangle with a flat roof, distinct from the surrounding darker soil and the large dark green tree cluster to its left. Its geometric shape and position within a developed area (indicated by the rows of larger buildings on either side) identify it as a small building or shed.
